title: 9 Standards a Godly Man Holds Himself To
caption:
9 standards a godly man holds himself to. That he'd never hold you to.

The apology he gives before you ask for one. The excuse he won't accept from himself. The sin he names out loud, not just in his head. The standard he raises the moment no one's grading him.

He measures himself against Christ, not against you. The grace he hands you first, and himself last. Gentle with you. Relentless with himself. That's the order Christ modeled.

#faith #godlyman #discipline #character #christianmen #integrity #grace
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
